title: Kid
description: A player's school-age character: a full, standard SF2E PC (see common/sf2e-common.schema.json#/$defs/pcStatblock) plus the campaign-specific fields that make a kid a kid — the induction terminal's intake answers and the link to the Frame they pilot. Level 1 at campaign start, advances by narrative milestone rather than XP budget. One file per kid in data/characters/kids/.

player.description: Which player controls this kid and their paired Frame.

pronouns.description: Free text (e.g. "She/her", "They/them") -- induction terminal Page 7. The terminal offers suggestions but never invents an answer.

genderIdentity.description: Free text -- induction terminal Page 7. Distinct from ancestry/appearance; not an SF2E mechanical field.

appearance.description: Free-text appearance notes -- induction terminal Page 7.

age.description: 17 is the charter age for civil-defense CONSCRIPTION, not a floor on the character — design/induction.md §1 settled that the party are volunteers and that volunteering has no age limit, so an older PC is legal and supported. A string is permitted because sf2e's own system.details.age.value is a free-text field and the induction terminal writes straight to it (design/induction-intake-audit.md §6a).

height.description: Free text, matching sf2e's own system.details.height.value -- induction terminal Page 7.

weight.description: Free text, matching sf2e's own system.details.weight.value -- induction terminal Page 7.

birthPlace.description: Where this character is from. Nobody in the party is from this city (design/induction.md §1); maps to sf2e's own system.details.biography.birthPlace -- induction terminal Page 7.

concept.description: One or two sentence character concept.

framePilotedRef.description: id of the Frame this kid pilots.

intake.description: Session-zero answers from the induction terminal's Page 7 (the Personality one-liners) and Page 8 (the five open questions and the freeform box) -- design/induction-terminal.md, revised by design/induction-intake-audit.md §6 on 2026-09-18, when the three banal questions and bible §20's eight were compressed into this shorter set. Raw answers, kept verbatim.

personality.description: One-line answers: likes, dislikes, attitude, beliefs, good-at. Each also written to its own real sf2e biography field on the Actor.

questions.description: The five open questions: allies, enemies, organizations, the Directorate secret, and the out-of-character player-goal question.

freeform.description: The single large catch-all box -- 'anything else, as much or as little as you like'. Written to sf2e's own Backstory field, and the home of the `concept` this terminal never used to capture.

intakeAnswer.description: One raw prompt id and the player's own words, kept verbatim. The id matches an entry in data/campaign/induction-intake-prompts.json.
